name: project-management-agent
description: JSON-backed project management agent demonstrating Ollama tool calling

scripts.test: npm run test:tools && npm run test:agent && npm run test:planning && npm run test:memory
scripts.test:tools: node -e "const t=require('./src/toolImpl'); const a=t.get_employee({name:'John'}); if(!a.ambiguous) throw Error('ambiguity failed'); if(t.get_tasks({projectId:'PROJ_ALPHA',overdue:true}).count!==2) throw Error('overdue failed'); if(!t.get_project({name:'Project Missing'}).error) throw Error('missing project failed'); console.log('tool checks passed')"
